title: Wasteland Reborn 2.0
description: The Classic Wasteland reborn 2.0 for wasteland lovers
body:
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a0e94e40e2b1a2e426cf40abb6dbe3a9474c5c7.png)




**About the mod:**
Adds a completely new world type with limited water and grass. A great mod for zombie apocalypse fans, which generally makes Minecraft survival challenging, especially when combined with other difficulty-increasing mods. Also planned are addons for "**Create and Create Aeronautical**."

This mod increases the **difficulty** and **simulates an apocalypse**.

- Structure spawn rates can be changed in the config: "Wasteland Reborn 2.0"


## To use the mod on a server, simply set the world type to "Wasteland" in the server configuration file.
## 
- Example for server.properties:
- level-type=wasteland_reborn:wasteland
- generate-structures=true
